info.description: The BeatPass API provides account-authorized platform data for approved developer integrations. External integrations require prior BeatPass approval; contact support@beatpass.ca. Protected operations require a Bearer token and endpoint-specific permission. Tokens expire after 90 days. The shared API budget is 300 requests per minute; additional limits can apply. Follow returned rate-limit headers and Retry-After. Examples use synthetic, nonfunctional fixtures and must not be sent to the live platform.

post.summary: Create a new track

name.description: Required clean track title, unique on creation. File extensions, metadata and artist references can be rejected.

artists.description: Credited artist IDs, or CURRENT_USER for the signed-in account's associated artist.

genres.description: Genre collection for the track. Use the plural genres field.

image.description: Required cover-art reference for a new track.

album_id.description: An existing album you are permitted to use.

exclusive_status.description: Required unless licensing_type is non_exclusive_only. A new track cannot be submitted as sold; that status is set after an exclusive license is issued.

exclusive_price.description: Required for an available exclusive offer. Express the amount in the major unit of exclusive_currency; omitted for an unavailable offer.

exclusive_license_config.description: Exclusive terms, supplied directly or through an accessible preset. Exclusive offers must promise WAV and stems in files_to_deliver and confirm deliverables_guaranteed for this specific track. Reusable presets do not supply that guarantee.

files_to_deliver.description: Must include wav and stems for exclusive offers.

deliverables_guaranteed.description: Must be true for exclusive offers; confirms the track-specific deliverables guarantee.

exclusive_license_preset_id.description: A preset available to the signed-in account. Reusable terms do not replace the track-specific deliverables guarantee.

ai_usage.description: Declare human_made or ai_assisted. Required when the upload flow requests AI disclosure; do not omit a declaration to avoid eligibility checks.

ai_tool_name.description: Required and nonblank when ai_usage is ai_assisted.

ai_usage_details.description: Required when ai_usage is ai_assisted. Must also contain at least 10 characters after trimming.

ai_commercial_rights_confirmed.description: Required and true when ai_usage is ai_assisted. Confirms commercial rights for the declared AI-assisted use.

url.description: Audio URL returned for your completed, authorized upload. Arbitrary remote audio URLs are not accepted for publication.

src.description: Audio reference returned by the same completed authorized upload. Do not substitute another account's file reference.

post.description:
Create a track after a completed audio upload authorized for your account. Requires upload permission and sufficient upload allowance. Complete the required metadata, licensing terms, deliverables guarantee, sample declarations, and AI disclosure as applicable. Producers can configure their catalog before payout setup; eligibility to acquire a new license or purchase is checked separately. A successful save does not establish completed processing or rights clearance.

post.description: Store or refresh an FCM device token for the authenticated user.

token.description: FCM registration token returned by the Firebase client SDK.

delete.description: Remove an FCM device token for the authenticated user. This endpoint currently expects the token in a JSON request body. Some HTTP clients or intermediaries may drop bodies on `DELETE` requests, so clients should ensure their stack preserves the payload. Keeping the token out of the URL avoids encoding and length issues with long FCM tokens.

get.description: Aggregate analytics for a Pro Page owned by the authenticated producer. Read availability before metrics. An onboarding response contains requirements instead of analytics. Preserve null rates, distinguish partial or unavailable measurement from zero, and keep revenue currencies separate. Responses are private and non-cacheable.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: At or after startDate; range at most 366 days.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: IANA time zone, such as America/Toronto.

get.description: Duration and completion analytics for a track your account is permitted to access. Tracked-duration plays can be fewer than total plays; missing data is distinct from a measured zero. Metrics are subject to review and need not equal public counters or earnings. Respect cache restrictions.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Relative period, such as 7-days, 30-days, 90-days or year, or explicit YYYY-MM-DD:YYYY-MM-DD range.
